draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kumily! This town sits in the Cardamom Hills, right next to Thekkady and the Periyar Tiger Reserve, so spice plantations are all around you.
draft.hungryLine: Kumily's main road has a couple of good places to eat, and you're in cardamom country, so pick up some spices while you're at it.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Lourdes Roman Catholic Church is a 2 min walk and Ganapathy Bhadrakali Temple about 5 min. Thekkady's wildlife sanctuary is just down the road.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take a slow walk among the cardamom plantations and enjoy the spicy smells of Kerala.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The Idukki Arch Dam, in this district, is said to be the world's second arch dam and Asia's first.

legends.title: The jeep safari truth
legends.body: Ask anyone who's done it and they'll tell you: on the jeep safari you hardly ever see animals, there's too much noise and too many people. Walking is better, you at least get the scenery.

legends.title: Asia's first arch dam
legends.body: Locals are proud that the Idukki Arch Dam is called the world's second and Asia's first arch dam. It's a day trip from Kumily.

tips.title: Take the morning boat.
tips.body: The early boat ride on Periyar Lake gives you the best chance of seeing animals.

tips.title: Skip the jeep safari.
tips.body: It's mostly a long drive through Vandiperiyar with little wildlife, so it's only worth it if you love off-roading.

story.title: Cardamom Hills
story.body: Kumily grew up in the Cardamom Hills of Idukki District. Spices are still what people come here for.

story.title: Asia's first arch dam
story.body: Up the road, the Idukki Arch Dam was built. It's called the world's second arch dam and the first in Asia.

story.title: Boats on Periyar Lake
story.body: Visitors paid a ₹500 entry fee to the reserve and ₹225 for a 1.5 hour boat ride on the lake. Mornings gave the best wildlife sightings.

story.title: Gateway to Thekkady
story.body: Kumily is the town at the edge of Thekkady and the Periyar Tiger Reserve. From here it's easy to reach Vagamon's pine trees and the Idukki sanctuary.
